title: Averaged dilation over the annulus (function term and kernel bound)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let R^n := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) carry Lebesgue measure. Let F : R^n → [0, ∞] be measurable, and let r, s, τ be reals with 1/2 ≤ r < 1, s > 0 and τ ≥ 1/2. Put B_ρ := ball(0, ρ) (open) and A := B_s \ B_{rs}. Then ∫_{[τ,1]} ∫_A F(t x) dx dt ≤ 2^{n+1} (1 - r) ∫_{B_s} F(y) dy. All integrals are lintegrals, the outer one over Icc τ 1 for Lebesgue measure on ℝ, and the constant enters via ENNReal.ofReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Rn n → ℝ≥0∞), Measurable F → ∀ r s τ : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ r → r < 1 → 0 < s → 1 / 2 ≤ τ → ∫⁻ t in Icc τ 1, ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) s \ ball 0 (r * s), F (t • x) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ (n + 1) * (1 - r)) * ∫⁻ y in ball (0 : Rn n) s, F y
